decision: Test a bounded <=2s Core input-queue drain only when the 12-request fixed cohort first becomes runnable, with same-service no-wait A / wait B / no-wait A-prime. Measure exact wait, requests gathered, prefill call count and latest-rank runtime/client envelope. This is a nonlinear threshold hypothesis after 250/500ms failed; reject if B does not gather nearly all requests or lacks material net benefit.
limits: Run171 Core add_request is processing time, not frontend arrival; a 2s wait may not gather all 12.
Run186 control and detailed cohorts have different admission shapes and are not a causal no-wait baseline.
Scenario arithmetic assumes identical per-forward cost and ignores scheduler, decode, cache and client effects; it is not an achievable bound.
Run173 500ms no-net result remains the prior negative evidence.
